meta.name: bedtime-story
meta.description: 为3-12岁儿童提供温馨亲切的睡前寓言故事和成语典故讲解。支持用户唤醒后提供故事列表选择，或直接讲解指定故事/成语。讲解时保持亲切温馨的语气、0.6倍正常语速、通俗易懂的表达，为小朋友营造舒适的睡前氛围。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为3-12岁儿童讲述温馨的睡前故事和成语典故
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果家里有3-12岁孩子，需要每晚讲睡前故事。
copy.tagline_en: Tell warm bedtime stories and idiom tales for children aged 3-12
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have kids aged 3-12 and need bedtime stories every night.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会变成儿童睡前故事讲解员:当你说要听故事,它会先给出20个寓言故事列表;选定后,用0.6倍语速、亲切的语气完整讲完故事或成语典故,并在结尾道晚安。
howto.when: 当你说「我要听故事」、报出具体故事名或成语、或发一个故事序号(如 3)时触发。

say.note: 会先推送20个寓言故事列表供挑选。
会直接完整讲解这个故事,不提供列表。
会讲解成语典故、含义和例句。

howto.what_en: It turns Claude into a children's bedtime storyteller. If you ask for a story, it first offers a list of 20 fables; once you pick one, it tells the full tale or idiom origin in a warm, gentle tone at 0.6x speed, ending with a goodnight.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'I want to hear a story', names a specific fable or idiom, or sends a story number like 3.

say_en.text: I want to hear a story.
say_en.note: It will push a list of 20 fables for you to choose from.

say_en.text: Tell me 'The Tortoise and the Hare'.
say_en.note: It tells that story in full, no list needed.

say_en.text: What does the idiom 'Shou Zhu Dai Tu' mean?
say_en.note: It explains the idiom's origin, meaning, and an example.
